harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: (يس) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] Letters with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «والقرآن»: [the wāw is] a particle of oath, and the thing sworn by is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) (أقسم, "I swear").

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «إنك لمن المرسلين» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (على صراط مستقيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {الْمُرْسَلِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «تنزيل»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb, i.e.: it was sent down.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «لتنذر»: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar {تَنْزِيلَ}. The clause «ما أنذر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قومًا», and the clause «فهم غافلون» is conjoined to the clause «ما أُنذر».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The preposition «على أكثرهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حقَّ». The clause «فهم لا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the clause «حق». The clause of the implied oath is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition «في أعناقهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object. The clause «فهي إلى الأذقان» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا», and the clause «فهم مقمحون» is conjoined to the clause «هي إلى الأذقان».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition «من بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object. The wāw in «ومِنْ خلفهم سدًا» conjoined the first object to the first and the second to the second. The clause «فهم لا يبصرون» is conjoined to the clause «أغشيناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «سواء»: khabar (predicate) placed first; the preposition «عليهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «سواء». The hamza is that of equalisation (taswiya), and it together with what follows it has the force of a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied form is: your warning and its absence are equal. The clause of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا}, and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «إنما»: the restraining [ما] and the restrained [إنّ] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The preposition «بالغيب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خشي». The clause «فبَشِّرْهُ» is conjoined to the clause «خشي».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «نحن»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of «إن». His words «وآثارهم»: conjoined to «ما». «كلَّ»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it; the implied clause «أحصينا» is conjoined to the clause «نكتب», and the clause «أحصيناه» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «واضرب» is resumptive. «أصحاب»: badal (substitute). «إذ»: a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «أصحاب», and the clause «جاءها» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «إذ»: a badal (substitute) of the first, a whole-for-whole substitute, and the fāʾs are conjunctions.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «مثلنا»: naʿt (adjective) of «بشر»; it did not become definite through the iḍāfa because it is vague. The clause «وما أنزل» is conjoined to the clause «ما أنتم إلا بشر», and «شيء» is the object of «أنزل». «إن» is negating. The clause «تكذبون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم», and the clause «إن أنتم إلا تكذبون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition «إليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مرسلون», and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «إنا إليكم لمرسلون» takes the place of the two objects of «يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition «علينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «البلاغ», and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause is conjoined to the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «لئن لم تنتهوا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «لنرجمنكم» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. The clause «ليمسَّنَّكم» is conjoined to the clause that is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «أئن ذكرتم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: you took an evil omen. The clause «أنتم قوم مسرفون» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وجاء رجل» is resumptive. The clause «يسعى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل». The clause «قال» is resumptive. «يا قوم»: the one addressed, in a construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the speaker.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The second clause «اتبعوا» is a badal (substitute) of the first. The clause «وهم مهتدون» is conjoined to the clause «لا يسألكم».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وما لي لا أعبد» is conjoined to the clause {اتَّبِعُوا}. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the clause «لا أعبد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «فطرني», and the preposition «إليه» is attached to «ترجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آلهة». «إن» is conditional. «لا تغن»: an imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by dropping the weak letter. «شيئا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: [availing] little or much. «ينقذون»: an imperfect verb, jussive by conjunction to the apodosis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the [remaining] nūn is that of protection (al-wiqāya), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: (إني إذا لفي ضلال مبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «إذًا» is a particle of answer.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فاسمعون» is conjoined to the clause «آمنت».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: (قيل ادخل الجنة قال يا ليت قومي) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun referring to the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb. «يا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, i.e.: they know of [my] forgiveness. The preposition «من المكرمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The wāw is resumptive. The preposition «من بعده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا». «جند»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من السماء» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جند». The clause «وما كنا» is conjoined to the clause «ما أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «إن» is negating, and the noun of «كانت» is a concealed [pronoun] referring to the punishment understood from the context. The clause «فإذا هم خامدون» is conjoined to the clause «إن كانت».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «حسرة»: the one addressed, resembling a muḍāf (shabīh bi-l-muḍāf). The preposition «على العباد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حسرة». The clause «ما يأتيهم» is resumptive; «رسول» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يأتيهم». The preposition «به» is attached to «يستهزئون».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «كم» is predicative (khabariyya), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من القرون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «أهلكنا» is the object of «يروا», which is suspended [from operating] by the predicative «كم». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنهم لا يرجعون» is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being: We decreed. The preposition «إليهم» is attached to «لا يرجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is negating, «كل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «لما» is a particle of restriction meaning «إلا», and «جميع» is the khabar (predicate) of «كل». «لدينا»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محضرون»; «محضرون» is a second khabar. The clause is conjoined to the clause {أَهْلَكْنَا}.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The wāw is resumptive. «آية»: khabar (predicate) placed first; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية»; «الأرض» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «أحييناها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأرض», and the clause «يأكلون» is conjoined to the clause «أخرجنا».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object. The preposition «من نخيل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات». The two preposition and its genitive nouns «فيها من العيون» are attached to «فجَّرنا».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فجرنا». The relative «ما» is conjoined to «ثمره». The clause «يشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «الذي»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلق».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «آية»: khabar (predicate) placed first; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية»; «الليل» is the mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later. The clause is conjoined to the clause «آية لهم الأرض» in verse (33). The clause «نسلخ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الليل», and the clause «فإذا هم مظلمون» is conjoined to the clause «نسلخ»; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The preposition «لها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مستقر». «والشمس» is conjoined to {اللَّيْلُ}. The clause «تجري» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الشمس», and the clause «ذلك تقدير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The wāw is a conjunction. «القمر»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the implied clause «خلقنا» is conjoined to the clause «والليل آية لهم». «منازل»: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ in «قدَّرناه» is by removal of the preposition, i.e.: We determined for it stations; the clause «قدَّرناه» is explicative. The preposition «كالعرجون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «عاد». The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن عاد) is genitive by «حتى», attached to «قدرناه».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تدرك» is the fāʿil (agent) of «ينبغي». «سابق» is the khabar (predicate) of «الليل». The clause «وكل في فلك يسبحون» is conjoined to the clause «ولا الليل سابق», and the preposition «في فلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسبحون».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The wāw is a conjunction. «آية»: khabar (predicate) placed first, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أنَّ» and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the implied form is: Our carrying their offspring is a sign. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The clause is conjoined to the clause «آية لهم الليل» in verse (37). The preposition «في الفلك» is attached to «حملنا».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The preposition «من مثله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَخَلَقْنَا}. The clause «فلا صريخ» is conjoined to the clause «نغرقهم», and the clause «ولا هم ينقذون» is conjoined to the clause «لا صريخ لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh). The preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة», and the preposition «إلى حين» is attached to a naʿt of «متاعاً».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what follows it, i.e.: they turned away. The adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «وما تأتيهم» is conjoined to the conditional clause. The preposition «من آية» is the fāʿil (agent) of «تأتيهم», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «من آيات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آية», which is preceded by negation. The preposition «عنها» is attached to «معرضين».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنفقوا». The clause «لو يشاء أطعمه» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. The clause «إن أنتم إلا في ضلال» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «إن» is negating.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «هذا». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «ما ينظرون» is resumptive. The clause «تأخذهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صيحة». The clause «وهم يخصمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. Its original form is يختصمون: the tāʾ was changed into ṣād, and when the two identical letters were to be assimilated, the first was made quiescent, so two quiescent letters met, the khāʾ and the first ṣād; so the first was given kasra to escape the meeting of two quiescent letters.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فلا يستطيعون» is conjoined to the clause {يَخِصِّمُونَ}. The clause «لا يرجعون» is conjoined to the clause «يستطيعون», and the preposition «إلى أهلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يرجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ونفخ» is conjoined to the clause {مَا يَنْظُرُونَ}. The preposition «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The fāʾ before «إذا» of surprise is a conjunction, and the clause «هم ينسلون» is conjoined to the clause «نفخ في الصور». The two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينسلون».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «قالوا» is resumptive. His words «يا ويلنا»: the one addressed, in a construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative. «من»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «من بعثنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «هذا ما وعد» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of a new speech.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «إن» is negating. The clause «فإذا هم جميع» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause] before it. The adverb «لدينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محضرون», which is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: His words «فاليوم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لا تظلم». «شيئاً»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: wronging little or much. The clause «لا تظلم» is conjoined to the content of an implied speech, i.e.: it will be said to them: today you are brought to account, and [no soul] will be wronged. The clause «يقال» is resumptive. «ما»: a relative noun, second object.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: «اليوم»: an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فاكهون». The preposition «في شغل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «فاكهون» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The preposition «في ظلال» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «هم»; «متكئون» is a second khabar, and the preposition «على الأرائك» is attached to the second khabar. The clause «هم متكئون» is a third khabar of {إِنَّ}.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فاكهة», and the clause «لهم فاكهة» is a fourth khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «سلام»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is what the preposition «من رب» is attached to. «قولا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that emphasises the content of the clause, its governing word being implied, and it together with its governing word is parenthetical between the mubtadaʾ and the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «امتازوا» is resumptive, and the vocative clause is resumptive. «المجرمون»: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «أن» is explicative (mufassira). The vocative clause is parenthetical. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو», and the clause «إنه لكم عدو» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: «أن» is explicative, and the clause «وأن اعبدوني» is conjoined to the explicative [clause] before it. The clause «هذا صراط» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «ولقد أضل منكم» is conjoined to the clause {أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ}, and the clause «لقد أضل» is the answer to the oath. The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جِبِلا». The clause «أفلم تكونوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «هذه جهنم» is resumptive. «التي»: naʿt (adjective) of «جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The adverb «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اصلوها». «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «اصلوها»; the bāʾ is causal.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {نَخْتِمُ}, and the clause «فاستبقوا» is conjoined to the clause «طمسنا». «الصراط» is accusative by removal of the preposition (إلى). His words «فأنى يبصرون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «استبقوا»; «أنّى» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause. The preposition «على مكانتهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسخناهم». The clause «ما استطاعوا» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «مضيًّا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «في الخلق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «يعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «وما علَّمناه» is resumptive, and the fāʿil (agent) of «ينبغي» is the pronoun of «الشعر». The clause «إن هو إلا ذكر» is resumptive, and «إن» is negating.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لينذر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e.: He sent it down.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) takes the place of the object of «يروا». The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أنعاماً». The clause «فهم لها مالكون» is conjoined to the clause «عملت», and the preposition «لها» is attached to «مالكون».

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «وذلَّلناها» is conjoined to the clause {خَلَقْنَا}. The clause «فمنها ركوبهم» is conjoined to the clause «ذَلَّلْناها», and the clause «ومنها يأكلون» is conjoined to the clause «منها ركوبهم».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «ولهم فيها منافع» is conjoined to the clause «منها ركوبهم», and the clause «يشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «واتخذوا» is resumptive. The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آلهة». The clause «لعلهم ينصرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «لا يستطيعون» is resumptive, and the clause «وهم لهم جند» is conjoined to the clause «لا يستطيعون». The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جند». «محضرون»: naʿt (adjective) of «جند».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فلا يحزنك» is resumptive, and the clause «إنا نعلم» is resumptive. «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «أولم ير الإنسان» is resumptive, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أنا خلقناه» takes the place of the two objects of «رأى». The clause «فإذا هو خصيم» is conjoined to the clause «أولم ير الإنسان»; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and «مبين» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «وضرب» is conjoined to the clause «هو خصيم». The clause «قال» is resumptive. The clause «وهي رميم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العظام».

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «قل» is resumptive. «أول»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its adjective having taken its place. The clause «وهو عليم» is conjoined to the clause «أنشأها», and the preposition «بكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «الذي»: badal (substitute) of the preceding relative noun. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object, and the preposition «من الشجر» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نارا». The clause «فإذا أنتم منه توقدون» is conjoined to the clause «جعل», and the preposition «منه» is attached to «توقدون».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «أوليس الذي ...» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ليس». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يخلق» is genitive by «على», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادر». «بلى»: a particle of answer. The clause «وهو الخلاق» is conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: yes, He is able to do that, and He is the Creator; «العليم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «إنما»: the restraining [ما] and the restrained [إنّ] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). «أمره» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن يقول». The conditional clause is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the implied form is: His command is His saying «كن». «كن» is a complete (tāmm) imperative verb. The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «يكون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: so it is (فهو يكون); the clause «فهو يكون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «فسبحان» is resumptive. The ṣila (relative clause) is the nominal clause after it, and the clause «وإليه ترجعون» is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
